environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). No additional middleware or filtering. SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db with read-write permissions for the app user. Environment variable APP_SECRET set to a static production value. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB forwards to port 8080 on instance.
